item.text: Palaeo-Agent computed Shannon diversity for all eight samples, with no exclusions. I’ll average the sample values by facies and check them against the counts. Its PCoA warning does not affect the diversity values.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python -c 'import csv,json,math,pathlib,statistics; import jsonschema
root=pathlib.Path(\".\")
r=json.loads(next(root.glob(\"community_run/*/results.json\")).read_text())
meta=list(csv.DictReader(open(\"samples.csv\")))
facies={x[\"sample_id\"]: x[\"facies\"] for x in meta}
assert len(facies)==len(meta)==8
with open(\"counts.tsv\") as f:
    rows=list(csv.reader(f,delimiter=\"\\t\"))
checks={}
for row in rows[1:]:
    counts=list(map(int,row[1:])); total=sum(counts)
    assert total>0 and all(x>=0 for x in counts)
    checks[row[0]]=-sum((x/total)*math.log(x/total) for x in counts if x>0)
assert set(checks)==set(facies)=={x[\"sample_id\"] for x in r[\"diversity\"]}
for x in r[\"diversity\"]:
    assert math.isclose(x[\"shannon\"],checks[x[\"sample_id\"]],rel_tol=1e-14,abs_tol=1e-14)
results={\"mean_shannon_\"+group:statistics.mean(x[\"shannon\"] for x in r[\"diversity\"] if facies[x[\"sample_id\"]]==group) for group in (\"reef\",\"lagoon\")}
answer=dict(status=\"completed\",results=results,assumptions=[],exclusions=[],issues=[],summary=\"Used Palaeo-Agent to compute sample Shannon diversity H = -sum(p_i ln(p_i)) from genus counts, joined samples to facies by exact sample ID, and calculated the arithmetic mean of four samples per facies. All eight samples were included. Independently verified sample diversity against the counts. The auxiliary PCoA negative-eigenvalue warning does not affect Shannon diversity.\")
jsonschema.validate(answer,json.load(open(\"answer.schema.json\")))
open(\"answer.json\",\"w\").write(json.dumps(answer,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+\"\\n\")
print(json.dumps(answer,indent=2))'"
